title: HIFLD Archive
description: An archive of the Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) program, a U.S. government resource of infrastructure datasets including administrative boundaries, hydrography, transportation networks, and critical infrastructure layers. The archive preserves hundreds of datasets from the decommissioned HIFLD geoplatform in cloud-optimized Parquet format.

## README.md
# Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Archive

The Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) program was a trusted resource for infrastructure data across the U.S. It supported policy, emergency management, and research before being discontinued in August 2025. This archive preserves that resource.

The datasets were processed using SeerAI Boson, Databricks, and Apache Sedona and saved in the Parquet format for ease of access directly on cloud object storage. If a dataset included geometry, it was spatially sorted using geohash level 8, which was then removed from the dataset.

## Dataset Directory Structure
Many of the original datasets contained multiple collections, and each collection was archived as its own parquet file. To preserve some of the original structure, there is a nested folder hierarchy for datasets and files. Please see below for the structure.

```
HIFLD
├── README.md                                       -> This file
├── hifld-dataset-inventory.csv                     -> Inventory of all datasets, their descriptions, any parent dataset folder, bucket location, and URL to vector tile JSON
├── 119th-congressional-districts                   -> Dataset parent folder
│   ├── README.md                                   -> Parent dataset README
│   ├── 119th-congressional-districts               -> Dataset folder
│   │   ├── 119th-congressional-districts.parquet   -> Dataset parquet
│   │   ├── README.md                               -> Dataset-specific README
├── 3d-hydrography-program-3dhp-layers              -> Dataset parent folder
│   ├── README.md                                   -> Parent dataset README
│   ├── catchment                                   -> Dataset folder - corresponding to collection in original dataset
│   │   ├── catchment.parquet                       -> Dataset parquet
│   │   ├── README.md                               -> Dataset-specific README
│   ├── flowline                 
│   │   ├── flowline.parquet               
│   │   └── README.md               
│   ├── ...     
├── ...
```
